spans.s: किशलय m.n. A sprout, a young shoot. See किसलय.
किसल n. A sprout, a young and tender shoot, किसलयैः सलयैरिव पाणिभिः R.ix.35, करकिसलयतालैर्भुग्धया नर्त्यमानम् Ut.iii.
किशोर m. 1. A youth, a lad, a boy below fifteen, a minor in law; 2. a colt, the young of any animal; 3. the sun.
किशोरी f. A maiden, a young woman.
किष्किंध(ध्य) m. 1. Name of a country; 2. name of a mountain situated in that country.
किष्किंधा(ध्या) f. Name of a city, the capital of Kishkindha.
किष्किंध(ध्य) m. 1. Name of a country; 2. name of a mountain situated in that country.
किष्किंधा(ध्या) f. Name of a city, the capital of Kishkindha.
किष्कु (II) m.f. 1. The forearm; 2. a cubit, a span.
किसल n. A sprout, a young and tender shoot, किसलयैः सलयैरिव पाणिभिः R.ix.35, करकिसलयतालैर्भुग्धया नर्त्यमानम् Ut.iii.
कीश (II) m. 1. An ape, a monkey; 2. the Sun; 3. a bird.
